title.en: SWAT+ output to Marine Modelling System (AquaINFRA) input connection tool

description.en: This code converts SWAT output (https://swat.tamu.edu/) of water quantity (Flow out and Temperature) in sqlite format to date input for the Marine Modelling System (based in MITgcm) in txt format. The tool uses R code al libraries DBI, RSQLite, and dplyr to correct the date format and dataframe structure.

swat_output_file.title: SWAT+ Variable Outputs Database
swat_output_file.description: SQLite database (thread_1.sqlite) storing the simulated output values based on the defined time range and time step (daily, monthly, yearly, or annual average).

output_file.title: River water quantity Marine Modelling System input
